scene_1.text_1: Shulker Packagers work much like regular Packagers.
scene_1.text_2: The difference is that they automatically teleport their packages over short distances.
scene_1.text_3: Before placing a Shulker Packager, right-click any Mechanical Arm output point or Packager to select an output target.
scene_1.text_4: After receiving a request, the Shulker Packager teleports the package to its selected target.
scene_1.text_5: Shulker Packagers are suited for short-range transport; for long-range transport, use Cargo Allay Stations, Package Frogports, Trains, Postboxes, and similar options.
scene_1.text_5_2: The Shulker Packager only teleports packages when the target can accept them. If the target is a Packager, it must be attached to a container.
scene_1.text_6: Check their Ponder screens to learn how they behave.
